name: Plugilo
description: plugilo is an AI-driven network with an innovative platform at its core. It offers a solution to optimize brand communication and effectively use and disseminate existing data consistently across the entire supply chain. The platform uses state-of-the-art AI technology and the experience of its employees to transform a wide variety of data types into a compact, standardized, and highly dynamic card format. These cards can represent product information, events, videos, editorial articles, and even people, thus transporting all company highlights. The prepared information can be disseminated from the manufacturer to distributors, dealers, and end customers. plugilo offers companies an organized content presentation, a disruption-free environment, a trustworthy source of content, integration into AI systems, network building on plugilo, thematic channels, targeted communication, promotion of brand loyalty, and personalized newsletters. As part of its Prime Partnership, plugilo offers companies free presence in thematic channels, building their own community through followers, personal network with partners & customers, precise GDPR-compliant analysis tools, all-round support for all plugilo activities, unlimited creation of cards & templates, and a free call center for customer networking.
ai_raw_response: Enriched data combined from multiple sources, including CB Insights, Tracxn, Datanyze, and PitchBook.

company_info.description: Plugilo is a digital content store and content management platform that connects users with brands by providing real-time product and company data. The platform leverages AI to power chatbots, image analysis, and predictive analytics.
